release_notes: Fixed: the in-panel update button failed with "unable to unlink old 'frontend/dist/assets/index.js': Permission denied" on every install done by install.sh. The script chowned the tree to www-data and only afterwards built the frontend as root — and because Vite empties and recreates frontend/dist on each build, the bundle and its directory came out root-owned, which is exactly what git needs write access to in order to replace the file. The chown now runs last, after the frontend build and the MCP dependency install, so the whole tree (including .git) belongs to the web server. run_update also recognises a permission failure and answers with the chown command instead of passing git's wording through.
